title: What Scripture Actually Means by Integrity
caption:
Integrity doesn't mean you never lied. It means whole. Undivided. The same man whether or not anyone's watching.

Check the room she's not in: what you let your boys say about her, the accounts you follow in private, the jokes you'd never say at her table. That's the real test, not the one to her face.

"Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out." Proverbs 10:9
